t: You're in Frank Banfield Park, a park in Hammersmith and Fulham. It's named after Frank Banfield, who lived from 1905 to 1970 and was a British politician. He served on the London County Council and later the Greater London Council, so this green space carries the name of someone who worked in London's local government. The material I have doesn't say more about his work here, so I'll leave you to enjoy the park itself.
